_about: Toggle 15 shot briefs (draft, before the concept judge): one frame per concept, generated 9:16 so the Story is composed first and the Feed is cropped from it. prompts.py joins shot + fidelity lock + scale + scene + light + grade + negatives. Every shot gives the 15 mm ring a referent it must match (pilot T01 drew it about 1.5x large against the neck).

shots.status: pilot shot 4 Nov: clasp right except the bar (two stones wide); about 1.5x large against the neck
shots.shot: Extreme close-up beauty macro photograph for a fine-jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame, of the base of a woman's throat and her upper breastbone only: the field of view is only about 8 centimetres wide, and the top edge of the frame sits at the hollow of the throat, so no chin, jaw, lips or face are in frame.
shots.scale: the whole frame is only about 8cm wide, so the 15mm ring spans about one fifth of the frame width; the skin shows true-size pores and fine vellus hairs, and the inner ends of the two collarbones just show at the upper left and upper right edges
shots.scene: the necklace is worn closed with the clasp turned to the front, the ring resting centred on the breastbone about 6cm below the hollow of the throat, in the middle of the frame; the two strands of paperclip links climb out of the top corners of the frame; warm medium-brown Indian skin with natural texture and a faint sheen, the soft neckline of an ivory silk camisole just entering at the very bottom edge; a dark believable contact shadow where the ring rests on the skin.

shots.shot: Close-up beauty macro photograph for a fine-jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame, of a woman's upper breastbone where the necklace's clasp rests, the field of view about 7 centimetres wide and the frame starting well below the hollow of the throat, so no neck creases, chin or face are in frame.
shots.scale: the frame is about 7cm wide, so the 15mm ring spans only about one fifth of the frame width; the tip of her left index finger rests on the chain just to the left of the clasp, the fingertip about 16mm wide, slightly wider than the ring and about four links long; skin pores and fine vellus hairs at true size
shots.scene: the necklace is worn closed with the clasp turned to the front and centred, a little above the middle of the frame, the two strands of paperclip links climbing out of the top corners; warm medium-brown Indian skin, natural texture and a faint sheen; the soft neckline of an ivory silk camisole crosses the lower third; a dark believable contact shadow under the ring.
shots.optics: Honest macro optics: depth of field only a few millimetres deep, so the clasp is needle-sharp and the chain softens as it climbs.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.scale: each ordinary office paperclip in the heap is about 33mm long and 8mm wide, three times the length of one 11mm necklace link, so the necklace's links read clearly smaller and finer than the paperclips; the 15mm ring is about half a paperclip long
shots.scene: a dense heap of hundreds of ordinary bright silver steel office paperclips fills the whole frame edge to edge, overlapping every which way on a pale blush paper desk that shows only in small gaps; lying on top of the heap in one loose oval loop is the gold necklace, closed, its clasp done up at the lower third of the frame, fully visible and in sharp focus; the gold is the only warm colour in the frame; every paperclip is plain silver wire, none gold, none coloured; a believable contact shadow where the gold rests on the clips.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft overhead window light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right puts a crisp bright line along the gold and makes the steel clips glint cool and silvery; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.neg: No coloured paperclips, no gold paperclips, no binder clips, no other stationery, nothing else on the desk.

shots.shot: Close-up fashion photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman's neck and upper chest in a chocolate-brown fine-ribbed knit turtleneck, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: the knit ribs are about 3mm apart; the fingertips of her right hand lightly touch the chain at the side, each fingertip about 16mm wide, the same width as the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the gold necklace is worn over the knit, the 50cm chain falling from under the folded turtleneck collar onto the chest in a soft U, the clasp done up and turned to the front at the centre, a little below the middle of the frame; warm cream wall softly out of focus behind; a believable shadow where the chain lies on the knit.
shots.light: LIGHT: low warm winter sun from a window at the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp bright line along the gold and puts a pin-point white catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: chocolate brown, cocoa, warm cream; warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain, believable imperfection; editorial demi-fine jewellery campaign quality.

shots.shot: Close-up photograph for a jewellery advertisement, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman fastening her necklace at the front, both hands at the base of her throat, cropped just below the chin so no face shows.
shots.scale: her fingertips are about 16mm wide, each a little wider than the 15mm ring; the ring sits between her two thumbs
shots.scene: the gold necklace hangs around her neck with the clasp at the front centre; her right thumb and index finger hold the ring, her left thumb and index finger hold the pave bar's jump ring at the ring's gate, as if she has just done it up; natural relaxed hands with five fingers each, short neutral nails, no rings; she wears a plain ivory cotton tank top; soft warm wall behind.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft warm morning window light from the left; one small hard specular kicker from the right draws a crisp line along the gold and puts a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.shot: Top-down overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, on a flat saturated cobalt-blue paper ground.
shots.scale: the word is about 12cm wide and 7cm tall, so each 11mm link is a small stroke of it; the 15mm ring is the size of a fingernail
shots.scene: the gold necklace lies open and is arranged by hand into the lowercase word 'hi' in joined-up handwriting, centred in the frame: the chain draws the 'h' and the stem of the 'i' in one continuous line, the pave bar sitting at the top of the h's tall stroke, and the round ring sitting just above the stem of the 'i' as its dot, joined to it by its last link; the word is clearly legible; nothing else on the paper.
shots.light: LIGHT: hard low sun from the upper left casts a crisp shadow of every link onto the blue paper; a small hard specular puts a bright edge along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone.
shots.grade: Palette: saturated cobalt blue, warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy, orange or greenish. Natural film grain; editorial still-life quality.
shots.neg: No other letters, no second word, no text printed on the paper.

shots.shot: Advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame: a woman's hand, fingers only from the knuckles, holds the necklace up by its chain between thumb and index finger near the top right of the frame.
shots.scale: the fingertip is about 16mm wide, slightly wider than the 15mm ring
shots.scene: the necklace hangs from her fingers in a long narrow loop with the clasp done up at the bottom, in front of a smooth warm lime-plaster wall; one small hard light close behind the camera throws the necklace's shadow onto the wall behind it, the shadow about three times larger than the necklace and offset down and to the left, every paperclip link and the ring's round shadow crisp and readable; the real necklace stays small and sharp.
shots.light: LIGHT: one small hard point light close behind the camera; a soft warm fill from the left; a crisp specular line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.

shots.shot: Overhead advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, of a small catch-all dish on a wooden console by a front door.
shots.scale: the round dish is about 12cm across; the brass house keys are about 55mm long on a steel split ring about 25mm across, so the necklace's 15mm ring is clearly smaller than the key ring
shots.scene: a round speckled ivory glazed ceramic dish on warm teak; inside it, a set of three brass house keys on a steel split ring, and the gold necklace coiled loosely beside them, closed, its clasp on top; the necklace's ring and the key ring sit side by side; nothing else in the dish.
shots.neg: No phone, no wallet, no sunglasses, no other objects.

shots.shot: Advertising photograph, vertical 9:16 frame, close on the door of an old Indian steel almirah (a steel wardrobe), painted soft grey-green.
shots.scale: the small brass key in the keyhole is about 5cm long; its round bow is about 25mm across, wider than the necklace's 15mm ring
shots.scene: the brass key sits in the almirah's chrome keyhole plate beside its chrome handle; the gold necklace hangs from the key's round bow, falling in a long loop down the painted steel door with the clasp done up at the bottom of the loop; the paint is slightly worn, with a believable sheen; nothing else in frame.
shots.light: LIGHT: soft daylight from a window at the left; one small hard specular kicker draws a crisp line along the gold and a pin-point catchlight in each tiny clear stone; the clear stones stay colourless.
shots.grade: Palette: grey-green painted steel, chrome, brass, warm-neutral 18k gold, never brassy or orange. Natural film grain, believable imperfection.
